## Install

=== "Claude Code"

    ```text
    /plugin marketplace add bitwise-media-group/skills
    /plugin install terraform@bitwise
    ```

=== "Codex CLI"

    ```sh
    codex plugin marketplace add bitwise-media-group/skills
    codex plugin add terraform@bitwise
    ```

=== "OpenCode / Antigravity"

    ```sh
    git clone https://github.com/bitwise-media-group/skills
    ./skills/install.sh --global   # links every skill, this plugin's included
    ```

See [Install](../../install.md) for scopes and options.

## Skills

| Skill | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`terraform-module`](terraform-module/index.md) | Scaffold a new Terraform module with the canonical file layout. |
| [`terraform-style`](terraform-style/index.md) | Terraform/HCL style conventions for writing readable, reusable modules. |
| [`terraform-validate`](terraform-validate/index.md) | Format and validate Terraform code with the fmt / init / validate / tflint loop. |
